# Best luxury buyers’ advocates on the Gold Coast

For a prestige home on the Gold Coast, I’d prioritise a **buyer-only advocate with genuine luxury-market experience, valuation-led acquisition advice, and access to off-market waterfront and beachfront properties** — rather than choosing a conventional prestige sales agency alone.

I reviewed local buyer’s agencies, their published service offerings, available review data and specialist luxury-property businesses. My shortlist below is based on suitability for a high-value acquisition, not simply who has the highest star rating.

The Gold Coast’s key prestige markets include Mermaid Beach, Main Beach, Broadbeach Waters, Sovereign Islands, Isle of Capri and Burleigh Heads. In these areas, pricing, waterfront position, building quality, flood exposure and resale potential can make a substantial difference to the value of a purchase. ## Where the shortlisted buyer’s agents are located

## How I would choose between them

For a prestige acquisition, I would assess each candidate against five criteria rather than rely on general customer reviews.

| Criterion | What to establish |
|--------|--------|
| Prestige track record | Recent completed purchases in your price bracket and target suburbs, not just general residential experience. |
| Off-market access | Specific examples of suitable homes secured before public listing, ideally with vendor and sale details that can be verified. |
| Valuation and negotiation | How they establish fair value using comparable settled sales and how they set a maximum purchase price. |
| Property-specific due diligence | Their process for flood exposure, waterfront or canal issues, building condition, title restrictions and strata records where applicable. |
| Independence and fees | Who pays them, whether they receive referral benefits, and whether the fee is fixed, percentage-based, retainer-plus-success or another structure. |


One particularly important point: **off-market does not automatically mean under market value.** The advocate should demonstrate why the property is worth buying at the proposed price, regardless of how it was sourced.

## My final shortlist

- **For a prestige waterfront home\:** start with BUYR.
- **For a highly tailored, design-conscious acquisition\:** interview Privée Property.
- **For a high-net-worth or international acquisition\:** speak with Queens Place.
- **For valuation-led pricing advice\:** compare Savvy Fox with Simply Gold Coast Property Advisors.
- **For full-service search and transaction management\:** include COAST Buyer’s Agency.

These are best-fit recommendations based on published positioning and available evidence, rather than a verified ranking of actual acquisition outcomes. Before appointing anyone, request comparable completed transactions, references from prestige-home buyers and a written scope of service.

search_results.title: Ray White TMG Luxury launches amid Gold Coast market downturn
search_results.description: Ray White TMG Luxury has launched amid a downturn in the Gold Coast property market, marked by four interest rate hikes, Middle East conflict, and changes to federal property tax policies. Ray White chief economist Nerida Conisbee remarked on the market’s uncertainty, though noting it is currently easier to transact. The launch featured a premium Broadbeach Waters property at 29 Namatjira Court with 95m of river frontage, 533 sq m of luxury living space, and high-end amenities such as a cocktail lounge and riverside pool. Despite a 3% decline in overall Gold Coast property values over the past year, the luxury segment in Broadbeach Waters remains resilient, mirroring stabilizing trends in Sydney’s Eastern suburbs and Melbourne’s South Yarra and Toorak. The event also marked the official unveiling of Ray White TMG Luxury, a new prestige-focused division led by CEO Matt Micallef. Micallef emphasized the division’s goal to provide a specialist approach for high-end buyers and sellers, asserting the Gold Coast's legitimacy as a top-tier luxury market. The luxury brand aims to respond to growing demand with dedicated, high-caliber service.

search_results.title: Villa Alcyone: Award-winning Elanora mansion eyes suburb record
search_results.description: Villa Alcyone, a Mediterranean-style mansion situated on a steep 890 sqm block at 6 Bicton Ct in Elanora, has entered the market with expectations to surpass the suburb's sales record by millions. Designed by Jayson Pate and built by Resolve Constructions, the award-winning home reflects a growing trend of luxury builders tackling challenging vertical sites. The property garnered multiple accolades at the 2026 HIA Gold Coast and Northern Rivers Awards and a Master Builders Queensland award. The four-bedroom, four-bathroom home spans 579 sqm and features high-end finishes such as Italian marble, dramatic archways, and a Sukabumi stone pool, all inspired by European influences during the owners' travels. Interior design was led by co-owner Helen Foukkare. Positioned to maximize ocean views and offering access to popular nearby beaches like Currumbin and Palm Beach, the mansion is drawing interest from high-end buyers typically focused on more traditionally prestigious areas. Although quarterly data shows a slight dip in Elanora home prices, the suburb's annual values rose 14.7 percent, reflecting its evolving luxury market appeal. The Foukkares are already planning another unique luxury build in the Gold Coast region.

search_results.title: Why Rachael Finch is selling her vacant Gold Coast block
search_results.description: Rachael Finch and her husband Michael Miziner, who rose to fame on Channel 7's Dancing With The Stars in 2010, purchased a vacant 859 sq m block on Pearl Drive in Helensvale, Gold Coast, for $1.75 million in November 2025. The move marked a new chapter for the couple, relocating to be closer to Finch's mother. Despite having their dream home design approved (DA approved) for the Serenity Shores gated estate, the couple listed the property for sale on October 14, 2026, through Amir Prestige Group agent Carlie Occhipinti. The waterfront block features 22.7m frontage, exclusive lock access to Saltwater Creek for vessels up to 48ft, and is surrounded by luxury homes. Though they initially settled in Queensland and introduced Finch’s wellness brand Kissed Earth to locals, their plans have since changed. Occhipinti confirmed the couple still resides on the Gold Coast but now requires a different location. This sale marks another shift for the couple, who also launched a café in Bondi in late 2025.

search_results.title: Gold Coast luxury property defies downturn as Sydney buyers move in
search_results.description: Despite a nationwide property downturn that has reverted prices and sales to 2023 levels, the Gold Coast luxury real estate market remains resilient. This strength is attributed to a limited housing supply, robust internal migration, and affluent buyers—particularly from Sydney—seeking better value. Michael Kollosche, managing director of Kollosche, highlights how high-end Gold Coast apartments, priced between $25,000 and $35,000 per square metre, offer better value compared to Sydney's $120,000 per square metre rates. Notable recent sales include an $11.5 million penthouse purchase by a European investor. According to Colliers, Gold Coast property prices have surged 84% since 2021, surpassing Brisbane and Greater Brisbane. Analyst Michael Matusik notes a shift from investment properties to owner-occupied beachfront homes, as the city attracts wealthy buyers post-pandemic. Downsizing among affluent homeowners along Hedges Avenue is driving demand for luxurious, smaller residences in the same prime locations. This demographic shift is shaping a robust, high-end market insulated from broader sectoral declines.

search_results.title: Surfers Paradise mega-penthouse heads to auction as Simon Beard 'meets market'
search_results.description: Simon Beard, founder of Culture Kings, and his wife Tah-nee are putting their luxurious four-level penthouse in Surfers Paradise up for auction after failing to sell it at the original $30 million asking price in 2024. Despite receiving strong offers at the time, Beard held out in hopes of setting a record, a decision he now regrets. With falling national home prices and rising interest rates, the couple is ready to meet the market and sell the property to the highest bidder. The exclusive penthouse atop the Soul building includes five bedrooms, seven bathrooms, panoramic views, a whisky bar, cigar lounge, eight-car garage, balcony gym, and Australia's highest private rooftop pool. Interior highlights feature opulent finishes such as a marble and brass staircase, custom chandeliers, and a $1 million sneaker display. Originally purchased for a record $15.25 million in 2021, the property is listed by agent Tolemy Stevens and will go to private auction on November 20, 2026. The Beards now live in a waterfront mansion nearby with their four children, which they bought for $11.75 million in 2020.

| Criterion | What to establish |
|--------|--------|
| Prestige track record | Recent completed purchases in your price bracket and target suburbs, not just general residential experience. |
| Off-market access | Specific examples of suitable homes secured before public listing, ideally with vendor and sale details that can be verified. |
| Valuation and negotiation | How they establish fair value using comparable settled sales and how they set a maximum purchase price. |
| Property-specific due diligence | Their process for flood exposure, waterfront or canal issues, building condition, title restrictions and strata records where applicable. |
| Independence and fees | Who pays them, whether they receive referral benefits, and whether the fee is fixed, percentage-based, retainer-plus-success or another structure. |

items.markdown:
One particularly important point: **off-market does not automatically mean under market value.** The advocate should demonstrate why the property is worth buying at the proposed price, regardless of how it was sourced.

## My final shortlist

- **For a prestige waterfront home\:** start with BUYR.
- **For a highly tailored, design-conscious acquisition\:** interview Privée Property.
- **For a high-net-worth or international acquisition\:** speak with Queens Place.
- **For valuation-led pricing advice\:** compare Savvy Fox with Simply Gold Coast Property Advisors.
- **For full-service search and transaction management\:** include COAST Buyer’s Agency.

These are best-fit recommendations based on published positioning and available evidence, rather than a verified ranking of actual acquisition outcomes. Before appointing anyone, request comparable completed transactions, references from prestige-home buyers and a written scope of service.
